deployment.description: Deployment configuration for the edge module. Adjust replicas based on expected load and HA requirements. Set to false if only single instance is supported or required.

kong.description: Custom Kong proxy timeouts. Use this only if different from default Kong configuration

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Java options used by the module launch descriptor (default: -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=66.0)

EnvVars.name: secure_store
EnvVars.description: Type of secure store for edge API keys: Ephemeral, AwsSsm or Vault

EnvVars.name: secure_store_props
EnvVars.description: Path to a properties file with secure store configuration

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_OKAPIURL
EnvVars.description: Okapi/Kong url (relaxed binding of folio.client.okapiUrl, replaces deprecated okapi_url).

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: Server port to listen on. Use 8443 when TLS for HTTP endpoints is enabled

EnvVars.name: SERVER_SSL_BUNDLE
EnvVars.description: SSL bundle used to configure TLS for HTTP endpoints, for example web-server

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEY_ALIAS
EnvVars.description: Alias of the key within the keystore for HTTP endpoints TLS

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the private key in the keystore for HTTP endpoints TLS

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Location of the keystore file for HTTP endpoints TLS

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the keystore for HTTP endpoints TLS

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the keystore for HTTP endpoints TLS: JKS, PKCS12 or BCFKS

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables or disables TLS for HTTP clients calling Okapi/Kong. Default: false

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTOREPATH
EnvVars.description: Location of the trust store file for HTTP clients. Can be omitted if the server provides a public certificate

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTOREPASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the trust store for HTTP clients. Can be omitted if the server provides a public certificate

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORETYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the trust store for HTTP clients: JKS, PKCS12 or BCFKS. Can be omitted if the server provides a public certificate

EnvVars.name: AWS_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region used by the AWS SDK when secure_store=AwsSsm

EnvVars.name: AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of attempts for AWS SDK requests (AWS SSM secure store)

EnvVars.name: AWS_RETRY_MODE
EnvVars.description: Retry mode of the AWS SDK (AWS SSM secure store)

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of the Log4j2 configuration file

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Environment

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the edge-fqm backend container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the edge-fqm module deployed alongside this sidecar
